'''Trent Jaspar''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who discovered his ability with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In an effort to find a teacher, he joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was assigned to [[Edan Base]] after the attack by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']].
